subject.title: [Feature]: Clickable file links in chat with file viewer sidebar; workspace navigator previews any in-root file

question: Should `sessions.files.get` be allowed to return any file under the session workspace root for the Control UI viewer, or should preview remain limited to transcript-touched files until a narrower workspace-read API is approved?
rationale: The UX request depends on serving untouched workspace files through an existing session RPC and `operator.read` scope, which automation should not approve without maintainer intent even with root containment and preview caps.

options.title: Allow bounded in-root preview
options.body: Permit `sessions.files.get` to serve any contained workspace file with existing size, symlink, hardlink, and traversal protections, then continue review on the linked PR.

options.title: Keep touched-file scope
options.body: Preserve the relevance-map gate and ask for a separate authorization or protocol design before arbitrary workspace file previews ship.

options.title: Split UI from read-scope change
options.body: Land chat link rendering and sidebar UI only for already-readable files, then decide workspace-wide reads separately.

recommendation.title: Allow bounded in-root preview
recommendation.body: Permit `sessions.files.get` to serve any contained workspace file with existing size, symlink, hardlink, and traversal protections, then continue review on the linked PR.

likelyOwner.reason: They opened the protected issue and linked PR and are the clearest owner for the requested UX and read-boundary decision.
